test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 2280. If a discount of 40 percent is given, then what will be the selling price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the article = Rs. 2280

Discount = 40%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price - (Discount × Marked Price)

**Calculation:**

Discount amount = 40% of 2280

Discount amount = 40/100 × 2280

Discount amount = 0.4 × 2280

Discount amount = 912

Selling Price = 2280 - 912

Selling Price = 1368

**The selling price of the article is Rs. 1368.**
